entities.name: Fahrudin Radončić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fahrudin Radončić is a Bosnian businessman and politician who served as Minister of Security from 2012 to 2014 and again from 2019 to 2020. He is the founder of Dnevni avaz, the best-selling newspaper in Bosnia and Herzegovina and is the founder and current president of the Union for a Better Future.

entities.name: Fahrudin Radončić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fahrudin Radončić is a Bosnian businessman and politician who served as Minister of Security from 2012 to 2014 and again from 2019 to 2020. He is the founder of Dnevni avaz, the best-selling newspaper in Bosnia and Herzegovina and is the founder and current president of the Union for a Better Future.
